invariants.rationale: The method is an instance method and `this` is implicitly non-null at entry.
The method accesses style.font and style.background, so style should be non-null.
The method calls text.equals and text.length(), so text must be non-null at entry.
The method accesses linesBreak.clear() and linesBreak.add(), so linesBreak must be non-null.
The code compares text.equals(lastText), so at least one being non-null avoids NullPointerException.
